title: Model2GDS: A Reproducible Decision-Fidelity Audit of GEMM Accelerator Models with Open-Source RTL-to-GDS Tools
research_question: Under a fixed and reproducible open-source backend implementation flow, how faithfully does a cycle-level GEMM accelerator model preserve the relative latency ordering and hardware-selection decisions among parameterized systolic-array configurations after RTL verification and post-route timing analysis?
